title: Planck-cosmology prediction for the COSMOS 3D mass map
method: Lognormal matter field in 60 slabs (z 0.00-3.00) with CAMB halofit power; real COSMOS galaxy positions and photo-z (true z scattered by 0.04(1+z)); Born-approximation reduced shear; real shape noise (measured shapes, randomly rotated); then the same reconstruction as the real map (prep/cosmos_3d.py).
caveat: A random universe with Planck's cosmology, statistically like the real one. It does not model the actual structures behind COSMOS, so individual clumps are not expected to line up.
grid_like: ../cosmos/cosmos_3d.json (same shape, bounds, redshift axis and layout)
stats_note: Hand-written manifest for the 3 exported realizations. Peak-count statistics are not computed yet: run prep/planck_mock.py to regenerate this file with them.
